python3 << 'PY'
import math

values = [64332, 10983, 109606, 122270, 735828, 97255, 64286, 27166, 417974, 222639,
          17231, 34037, 271859, 100945, 49175, 66239, 61165, 62871, 18204, 101598,
          161146, 178509, 170442, 31420, 119199, 15993, 35205, 45885, 20345, 187735,
          19766, 350082, 190438, 12812, 235458, 60206, 71863, 257446, 25975, 65892,
          12334, 169376, 536530, 60537, 8471, 162666, 209293, 13475, 117667, 7638]

# Sort ascending
sorted_vals = sorted(values)
print("Sorted ascending (first 10):", sorted_vals[:10])
print("Sorted ascending (last 10):", sorted_vals[-10:])

n = len(sorted_vals)
k = 7

# Hill estimator: use the k largest values
# Sorted ascending: X_{(1)} ... X_{(n)}
# The k largest are X_{(n-k)} ... X_{(n-1)} (0-indexed: index n-k to n-1)
# Hill estimator = (1/k) * sum_{i=1}^{k} log(X_{(n-i+1)} / X_{(n-k)})
# = (1/k) * sum_{j=0}^{k-1} log(X_{(n-1-j)} / X_{(n-k)})

threshold = sorted_vals[n - k]  # X_{(n-k)} in 1-indexed notation
print(f"\nn = {n}, k = {k}")
print(f"Threshold X_{(n-k)} (the {k}th largest, 1-indexed) = {threshold}")

k_largest = sorted_vals[n - k:]  # The k largest values (ascending order among top-k)
print(f"k largest values (sorted asc): {k_largest}")
print(f"k largest values (desc): {sorted(k_largest, reverse=True)}")

# Hill estimator formula
# α̂ = (1/k) * sum_{i=1}^{k} log(X_{(n-i+1)} / X_{(n-k)})
# where X_{(n-i+1)} are the k largest values (from largest to smallest)

sum_logs = 0.0
for i in range(1, k + 1):
    # X_{(n-i+1)} is the (n-i+1)th smallest = the ith largest
    # 0-indexed: sorted_vals[n-i] is the ith largest (i=1 is largest)
    val = sorted_vals[n - i]
    ratio = val / threshold
    log_ratio = math.log(ratio)
    sum_logs += log_ratio
    print(f"  i={i}: X_{(n-i+1)} = {val}, ratio = {ratio:.6f}, log = {log_ratio:.6f}")

alpha_hat = sum_logs / k
print(f"\nSum of logs = {sum_logs:.6f}")
print(f"Alpha (Hill) = {alpha_hat:.6f}")
print(f"Rounded to 3 decimal places = {round(alpha_hat, 3)}")

import math

values = [64332, 10983, 109606, 122270, 735828, 97255, 64286, 27166, 417974, 222639,
